name: More Shenanigans
description: More Shenanigans is a neighborhood bar renowned for its lively karaoke nights, often held on weekends. The venue offers a welcoming atmosphere with friendly staff and regular patrons, making it a great spot to sing your heart out. The bar features a good selection of drinks and food, creating a fun, relaxed environment where everyone knows your name. While hours can vary, the consistent karaoke nights make it a popular local hangout for music lovers and social groups alike.
